0.long_answer: Ovarian cancer is the type of cancer that has the highest mortality rate among cancers affecting the female reproductive system. Although pelvic pain can be associated with various gynecologic cancers, ovarian cancer is particularly lethal because it is frequently diagnosed at an advanced stage, making timely treatment challenging. The subtle early symptoms and deep pelvic location contribute to later detection. As a result, ovarian cancer, despite being less common than some other reproductive cancers like cervical cancer, results in more deaths due to its aggressive nature and diagnostic challenges.
